svg.title: The geometric size estimate Msv gives the required envelope rate at vertex v, and also actual convergence of every descendant displacement to zero. The sibling lower bound ηsv gives separation at every exponent strictly larger than av. Induction over the tree thus gives all the regularity hypotheses of the preceding rate proof, including vertices with av = 0. Since P av = 1, the slack ε P ∆v is strictly positive, as required in (NE4). Applying the rate estimates gives (NE2) and (NE3) eventually on this refining filter.
